purpose: BRIDGE VERIFICATION — prove the files.list -> file_id -> Drive upload_file(file_uri) path end to end, then write the verified pointer back to git. No production consumer yet.

image.prompt: A single glowing orange funnel on a pure black background, minimal line-art style, thick clean strokes, centered, no text anywhere in the image.
image.style: minimal line art, orange on black, high contrast

steps: read this file from the repo to get the image concept
generate the image with the image tool
call files.list and read the generated image's real file_id
pass that exact file_id as file_uri to Google_Drive.upload_file — NOT /mnt/data, NOT a sandbox URL, NOT a filename
read the file back from Drive and confirm its file id and link
write exchange/responses/image-20260730-demo-01.json per the schema in exchange/README.md and commit it to main
notes: image.sha256 must be the hash of the bytes actually uploaded — the consumer recomputes it after download and rejects a mismatch. If any step fails, write the response with status unsupported/failed and name the blocking step; do NOT fabricate a pointer.
